notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 New 2 step Weapon Reloading
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.0 

The [b]Oculus Quest link[/b] cable has been fixed. The menu and grip buttons were not working when you play the game. Thank you to [b]Joe and Friedya[/b] from the [b]community[/b] for helping us find and fix that issue.


[list]
[*] New two step reloading mechanics for machine guns and hand weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/7b3dd0206dbe96c56ce5ac1dd756f51fc35a989e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Changes for reloading have been made to create more immersion and reward aim accuracy. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] A red dot sight has been added to the StG 44 in later levels to improve the ability to get headshots on the tougher enemy types.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Bazooka damage has also been increased to vehicles and infantry.
[/list] 
[list]
[*] A new weapon, the VG1-5 has been added to the last stage of the Tank Commander Mode. This is a late war German assault rifle made as a cheaper version of the StG44. VG1-5 stands as the faster firing, more rugged version of the StG44.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/76e3daef9dc816ea36aa7aed91265201efd2ce34.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Checkpoints have been added to some of the longer stationary encounters.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Improvements to certain UI elements and game encounters.
[/list]



Thanks for playing.
Best
10th Reality

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
1.0.9 has some additional physics hot fixes and a few FX improvements.

-Fixed a physics issue where the player tank does not register the ground correctly
-Some FX improvements made to enemy vehicle destruction animations

Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
1.0.8 has some bug hotfixes, usability pass, and FX improvements.

-Fixed a physics issue that was messing with the players ability to grab things
-Fixed the sniper scope not always rendering when equipped.
-Adjusted the size of the turret 30cal projectile to make it easier to use.
-All buildings in Commander Mode are now destructible.

Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Based on feedback and testing some minor changes have been made to the game to make things more clear and improve the players experience.
[list]
[*] Changed the the 30cal turret tracers to be more visible
[*] Adjusted particles to make it more clear when you can use the fire extinguisher
[*] Adjust some encounters and tank mechanics based on player feedback
[*] Adjusted the tank commander mode and starting barn tutorial to instruct the player better
[*] Various main menu and UI updates
[/list]
Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/0d3e961f0a7c541a0c004df9ef73f2db4049b6ac.png[/img]
Some new weapons have been added and the AI systems have been overhauled in preparation for the Tank Battle Mode.
[list]
[*] Webley pistol: A power revolver that can take out many enemies with one head shot.
[*] PPSH41: A fast rate of fire SMG with a large drum magazine. 
[*] StG44: A powerful assault rifle capable of reliable sustained damage.
[*] Fire sounds have been improved on all the weapons in the game.
[*] Existing weapons have been adjusted to make every weapon more unique.
[*] Added recoil when zoomed into the scope to make shots feel more impactful.
[*] Adjusted the grenade mechanics to be more user-friendly.
[*] Added in more behaviors for the enemy AI within the arcade mode.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]
